info.title: WaveMP API
info.description: REST API of WaveMP, a nostalgic media player.

get.summary: Lists the albums, sorted and optionally searched and filtered.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of albums of the page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort key; Artist by default, Relevance with q. Relevance without q falls back to the default.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Sort direction; descending by default for FirstSeenAt and Relevance, otherwise ascending.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text: only albums whose title or album artist contains it or is similar to it (small typos).

parameters.name: artistId
parameters.description: Only albums with this album artist or with tracks of this artist.

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Only albums with tracks of this genre, without regard to case.

parameters.name: myMusic
parameters.description: Only albums with tracks of the "my music" of the current profile. Combines with all other filters.

get.summary: Returns an album.

404.description: The album does not exist (code `album.not_found`).

get.summary: Lists the tracks of an album, by default in the order of disc and track number.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of tracks of the page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort key; Album (disc and track number) by default, Relevance with q. Relevance without q falls back to the default.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Sort direction; descending by default for FirstSeenAt and Relevance, otherwise ascending.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text: only tracks whose title, artist or album contains it or is similar to it.

parameters.name: hasAudio
parameters.description: Only tracks with (true) or without (false) an audio file.

parameters.name: hasVideo
parameters.description: Only tracks with (true) or without (false) a video file.

404.description: The album does not exist (code `album.not_found`).

get.summary: Returns the cover of an album as picture: the picture in its folder, otherwise the cover of one of its tracks. With size, the picture is scaled to fit into a square of 96, 300 or 1000 pixels (the requested size rounded up, at most 1000; never enlarged) and delivered as WebP from the cache; without size, as stored (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF or BMP). Every picture carries a strong ETag of its version and size, Last-Modified and Cache-Control: private, no-cache; a request with a matching If-None-Match returns 304.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Largest width and height in pixels the client shows the picture with (1 to 4096); the server rounds it up to 96, 300 or 1000.

404.description: The album does not exist (code `album.not_found`) or has no cover (code `cover.not_found`).

get.summary: Lists the artists, sorted and optionally searched.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of artists of the page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort key; Name by default, Relevance with q. Relevance without q falls back to the default.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Sort direction; descending by default for FirstSeenAt and Relevance, otherwise ascending.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text: only artists whose name contains it or is similar to it (small typos).

parameters.name: myMusic
parameters.description: Only artists of the "my music" of the current profile, as track or album artist.

get.summary: Returns an artist.

404.description: The artist does not exist (code `artist.not_found`).

get.summary: Lists the albums of an artist: albums with the artist as album artist and albums with tracks of the artist.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of albums of the page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort key; Artist by default, Relevance with q. Relevance without q falls back to the default.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Sort direction; descending by default for FirstSeenAt and Relevance, otherwise ascending.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text: only albums whose title or album artist contains it or is similar to it.

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Only albums with tracks of this genre, without regard to case.

404.description: The artist does not exist (code `artist.not_found`).

get.summary: Returns how much space the cache uses, in total and per area, and its size limit.

delete.summary: Removes all files of the cache. Covers are created again the next time they are shown or after the next scan, transcoded segments the next time they are played.

get.summary: Lists the favorites of the current profile with their tracks, albums and artists, the newest first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of favorites of the page.

put.summary: Marks a track as favorite of the current profile. A track marked before keeps the time it was marked.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`).

delete.summary: Removes a track from the favorites of the current profile; also succeeds if it is no favorite.

put.summary: Marks an album as favorite of the current profile. An album marked before keeps the time it was marked.

404.description: The album does not exist (code `album.not_found`).

delete.summary: Removes an album from the favorites of the current profile; also succeeds if it is no favorite.

put.summary: Marks an artist as favorite of the current profile. An artist marked before keeps the time it was marked.

404.description: The artist does not exist (code `artist.not_found`).

delete.summary: Removes an artist from the favorites of the current profile; also succeeds if it is no favorite.

get.summary: Lists the genres of the tracks with the number of their tracks and albums. Genres that differ only in case are one genre; use its name as genre filter of the track and album lists.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of genres of the page.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Sort direction; descending by default for TrackCount, otherwise ascending.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text: only genres that contain it or are similar to it.

parameters.name: myMusic
parameters.description: Only genres of the "my music" of the current profile, counted over these tracks.

get.summary: Returns the health of the service.

200.description: The service is healthy or degraded.

503.description: At least one health check failed (code `health.unhealthy`).

post.summary: Records a play of a track. Clients send it once the track has played for half its duration or four minutes, whichever comes first, and may send it later (up to seven days) with the time the play started.

201.description: The new entry; Location points to it.

400.description: The request is invalid, for example playedAt in the future or older than seven days (code `request.invalid`).

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`).

get.summary: Lists the plays of the current profile, the newest first. Plays of tracks that left the library are gone.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of entries of the page.

get.summary: Returns an entry of the play history of the current profile.

404.description: The entry does not exist or belongs to another profile (code `history.not_found`).

get.summary: Returns all rows of the home page of the current profile in one call: own playlists, recently played tracks, recently added albums, favorites and top rated tracks. Every row is the first page of its list.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items per row.

200.description: The rows of the home page.

get.summary: Lists the jobs with their state, schedule, next and last run.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of jobs of the page.

200.description: One page of jobs, sorted by id.

post.summary: Starts a run of the job now. It runs in the background.

202.description: The run is queued; Location points to it.

404.description: The job does not exist (code `job.not_found`).

409.description: The job is already queued or running (code `job.already_running`).

get.summary: Lists the runs of the job by the time they were requested, newest first by default, optionally filtered. Runs older than 30 days and beyond the 100 newest are removed automatically.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of runs of the page.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Sort direction; ties are sorted by id.

404.description: The job does not exist (code `job.not_found`).

get.summary: Returns a run of the job.

404.description: No such job or run (code `job.not_found` or `job.run_not_found`).

get.summary: Returns the settings of the current profile.

404.description: The profile was deleted in the meantime (code `user.not_found`).

patch.summary: Changes the settings of the current profile. Missing or null values stay unchanged.

404.description: The profile was deleted in the meantime (code `user.not_found`).

get.summary: Returns the own cover of a playlist as square WebP picture of 96, 300 or 1000 pixels (the requested size rounded up, at most 1000; never larger than the uploaded picture). Every picture carries a strong ETag of its version and size, Last-Modified and Cache-Control: private, no-cache; a request with a matching If-None-Match returns 304.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Largest width and height in pixels the client shows the picture with (1 to 4096); the server rounds it up to 96, 300 or 1000. The largest picture if missing.

404.description: The playlist does not exist or belongs to another profile (code `playlist.not_found`) or has no own cover (code `cover.not_found`).

put.summary: Uploads the own cover of a playlist as the raw bytes of a JPEG, PNG or WebP picture (10 MiB at most by default). The server cuts the largest square out of the middle, scales it down and stores it as WebP; the uploaded file itself is not kept. Replaces an earlier own cover.

200.description: The playlist with its new cover.

404.description: The playlist does not exist or belongs to another profile (code `playlist.not_found`).

415.description: The content is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP picture (code `cover.unsupported_format`).

503.description: Pictures cannot be processed, ffmpeg is missing (code `service.unavailable`).

delete.summary: Removes the own cover of a playlist; the playlist then shows the covers of its tracks again. Succeeds also without an own cover.

204.description: The playlist has no own cover.

404.description: The playlist does not exist or belongs to another profile (code `playlist.not_found`).

get.summary: Lists the entries of a playlist in their order. Entries of tracks that left the library are gone.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of entries of the page.

404.description: The playlist does not exist or belongs to another profile (code `playlist.not_found`).

post.summary: Adds tracks to a playlist, at the end or at a position. The same track can be added several times.

201.description: The new entries and the changed playlist; Location points to the first new entry.

400.description: The request is invalid, e.g. a position after the end (code `request.invalid`, `out_of_range` with the largest allowed position as max).

404.description: The playlist does not exist or belongs to another profile (code `playlist.not_found`) or a track does not exist (code `track.not_found`).

409.description: The playlist would have more entries than allowed (code `playlist.full`).

get.summary: Returns an entry of a playlist with its current position.

404.description: The playlist does not exist or belongs to another profile (code `playlist.not_found`) or the entry does not exist in it (code `playlist.entry_not_found`).

patch.summary: Moves an entry of a playlist to another position.

400.description: The request is invalid, e.g. a position after the last entry (code `request.invalid`, `out_of_range` with the largest allowed position as max).

404.description: The playlist does not exist or belongs to another profile (code `playlist.not_found`) or the entry does not exist in it (code `playlist.entry_not_found`).

delete.summary: Removes an entry from a playlist; the entries after it move up. Other entries of the same track stay.

404.description: The playlist does not exist or belongs to another profile (code `playlist.not_found`) or the entry does not exist in it (code `playlist.entry_not_found`).

get.summary: Lists the playlists of the current profile, sorted and optionally searched.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of playlists of the page.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text: only playlists whose name contains it, without regard to case.

post.summary: Creates a playlist of the current profile, optionally with its first tracks.

201.description: The new playlist; Location points to it.

400.description: The request is invalid, e.g. a name of spaces only (code `request.invalid`).

404.description: A track does not exist (code `track.not_found`).

409.description: More tracks than a playlist may have (code `playlist.full`).

get.summary: Returns a playlist of the current profile.

404.description: The playlist does not exist or belongs to another profile (code `playlist.not_found`).

patch.summary: Renames a playlist of the current profile.

404.description: The playlist does not exist or belongs to another profile (code `playlist.not_found`).

delete.summary: Deletes a playlist of the current profile with its entries and its cover. The tracks stay in the library.

404.description: The playlist does not exist or belongs to another profile (code `playlist.not_found`).

get.summary: Lists the profiles in the order they were created; the built-in admin profile comes last.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of profiles of the page.

get.summary: Lists the tracks the current profile played last, newest first: every track once, at its last play, at most 100 tracks by default. Tracks that left the library are gone.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of tracks of the page.

post.summary: Starts a scan of the whole media folder. The scan runs in the background; follow it with the current scan.

202.description: The scan is queued; Location points to it.

409.description: A scan is already queued or running (code `scan.already_running`).

get.summary: Lists the scans by the time they were requested, newest first by default, optionally filtered.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of scans of the page.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Sort direction; ties are sorted by id.

get.summary: Returns the queued or running scan with its progress.

404.description: No scan is queued or running (code `scan.not_running`).

get.summary: Returns a scan with its result, or its progress while it runs.

404.description: The scan does not exist (code `scan.not_found`).

get.summary: Searches artists, albums and tracks at once and returns the best matches of each, sorted by relevance. Finds texts that contain the search text or are similar to it, so small typos are fine. Tracks are also found by their artist and album. To see more of a group, use the parameter q of its list.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text, 1 to 200 characters; white space only is invalid.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of matches of each group to skip.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of matches of each group.

post.summary: Selects a profile: creates a session and returns its token.

201.description: The session with its token; Location points to the current session.

404.description: The profile does not exist (code `profile.not_found`).

get.summary: Returns the session of the token, with its profile.

401.description: No valid token, or the session has ended (code `auth.unauthorized`).

delete.summary: Ends the session of the token (switching the profile); the token is no longer accepted.

401.description: No valid token, or the session has ended (code `auth.unauthorized`).

get.summary: Returns the settings of the media library.

patch.summary: Changes the settings of the media library. Missing or null values stay unchanged. A new scan interval and the file watcher apply at once, the lists with the next scan.

200.description: The changed settings, normalized (e.g. extensions in lower case without dot).

400.description: The request is invalid (code `request.invalid`, errors by field).

get.summary: Returns the settings of the cache.

patch.summary: Changes the settings of the cache. Missing or null values stay unchanged. A lower size limit cleans up the cache in the background at once.

400.description: The request is invalid (code `request.invalid`, errors by field).

get.summary: Returns the settings of the transcoding.

patch.summary: Changes the settings of the transcoding. Missing or null values stay unchanged. New transcodes use the new values at once, running ones keep theirs; a change of the hardware acceleration starts a new detection of the graphics hardware in the background.

400.description: The request is invalid (code `request.invalid`, errors by field).

get.summary: Returns the HLS master playlist of a track with its one variant. The URI of the media playlist is relative and carries the signed query.

parameters.name: media
parameters.description: The video with its sound (default) or only the sound.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: Signed media URL: id of the user the URL was issued to.

parameters.name: sid
parameters.description: Signed media URL: id of the session the URL was issued in.

parameters.name: exp
parameters.description: Signed media URL: expiry in Unix seconds.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`), has no video (code `track.no_video`) or no sound (code `track.no_audio`), or its file is gone since the last scan (code `stream.file_missing`).

500.description: The duration of the file is unknown (code `transcode.failed`).

get.summary: Returns the HLS media playlist of a variant: all segments of the file with their durations. The URIs of the segments are relative and carry the signed query.

parameters.name: media
parameters.description: The video with its sound or only the sound.

parameters.name: variant
parameters.description: The variant from the master playlist.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: Signed media URL: id of the user the URL was issued to.

parameters.name: sid
parameters.description: Signed media URL: id of the session the URL was issued in.

parameters.name: exp
parameters.description: Signed media URL: expiry in Unix seconds.

404.description: As for the master playlist, or the variant is outdated because the file or the settings changed (code `transcode.variant_outdated`; load the master playlist again).

500.description: The duration of the file is unknown (code `transcode.failed`).

get.summary: Returns a segment of a variant (MPEG-TS). A missing segment is transcoded first: the request waits until it is ready, and a segment far from the running transcode (a seek) starts a new transcode at the segment.

parameters.name: media
parameters.description: The video with its sound or only the sound.

parameters.name: variant
parameters.description: The variant from the master playlist.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: Signed media URL: id of the user the URL was issued to.

parameters.name: sid
parameters.description: Signed media URL: id of the session the URL was issued in.

parameters.name: exp
parameters.description: Signed media URL: expiry in Unix seconds.

404.description: As for the media playlist, or the variant has no such segment (code `transcode.segment_not_found`).

503.description: Nothing can be transcoded (code `transcode.unavailable`), all transcode slots are in use (code `transcode.busy`) or the segment was not ready in time (code `transcode.timeout`); the last two with Retry-After.

get.summary: Lists the tracks, sorted and optionally searched and filtered.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of tracks of the page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort key; AlbumArtist by default, Relevance with q. Relevance without q falls back to the default.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Sort direction of the key; descending by default for FirstSeenAt, Relevance and Rating, otherwise ascending. Disc and track number always ascend.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text: only tracks whose title, artist or album contains it or is similar to it (small typos).

parameters.name: artistId
parameters.description: Only tracks of this artist or on albums of this album artist.

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Only tracks of this genre, without regard to case.

parameters.name: hasAudio
parameters.description: Only tracks with (true) or without (false) an audio file.

parameters.name: hasVideo
parameters.description: Only tracks with (true) or without (false) a video file.

parameters.name: myMusic
parameters.description: Only tracks of the "my music" of the current profile: rated, marked as favorite (also through their album or artist) or in one of its playlists. Combines with all other filters.

get.summary: Returns a track.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`).

put.summary: Rates a track for the current profile with 1 to 5 stars; 0 removes the rating. Every profile has its own ratings.

400.description: The rating is missing or not between 0 and 5 (code `request.invalid`, field `rating` with `required` or `out_of_range` with min and max).

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`).

get.summary: Returns the cover of a track as picture. By default the cover of its album comes before its own cover; if the preferred cover is missing, the other one is used, and finally the cover of another track of the album. With size, the picture is scaled to fit into a square of 96, 300 or 1000 pixels (the requested size rounded up, at most 1000; never enlarged) and delivered as WebP from the cache; without size, as stored (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF or BMP). Every picture carries a strong ETag of its version and size, Last-Modified and Cache-Control: private, no-cache; a request with a matching If-None-Match returns 304.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Largest width and height in pixels the client shows the picture with (1 to 4096); the server rounds it up to 96, 300 or 1000.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`) or has no cover (code `cover.not_found`).

get.summary: Lists the files of a track, for admins only: audio, video and its own pictures, also duplicates of lower quality, with their technical details.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of files of the page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort key; Kind (audio, video, pictures, the primary file first) by default.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`).

get.summary: Returns the metadata of a track as the metadata editor shows it, for admins only: the values of the tags of its audio file (values the tags do not contain come from the library, e.g. the folder and file name), whether the editor can write them and the audio file it writes. The file is checked each time.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`).

patch.summary: Writes metadata into the tags of the audio file of a track, for admins only, and reads the track again. Missing members stay unchanged; null or an empty text removes the value from the tags, and the library derives it from the folder and file name again. The previous tags are saved in the database first. Only the audio file that the track plays is written, never videos; file names stay as they are.

200.description: The metadata of the track after reading it again.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`).

409.description: The track has no audio file (code `track.no_audio`) or its audio file cannot be written (code `track.not_writable`).

get.summary: Decides how the client plays the audio of a track: directly, if it supports the format of the file, otherwise transcoded to AAC as an HLS stream (also the sound of tracks that only have a video). The answer contains a signed, short-lived stream URL that works without the session token, for example in an audio element: the file (protocol File) or the HLS master playlist (protocol Hls; null if transcoding is unavailable). It is valid for some time plus the duration of the track and while the session is active; clients ask again for a new one when it has expired. The answer also carries the ReplayGain tags of the file.

parameters.name: audioFormats
parameters.description: The audio formats the client plays (1 to 20, repeated query parameter).

200.description: How the client plays the track.

400.description: Missing, too many or invalid formats (code `request.invalid`).

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`), has neither an audio file nor a video (code `track.no_audio`) or its file is gone since the last scan (code `stream.file_missing`).

get.summary: Streams the audio file of a track as it is, with HTTP range requests (Accept-Ranges: bytes, 206 Partial Content), a strong ETag of the file version, Last-Modified and Cache-Control: private, no-cache. Besides the session token, it accepts the signed URL of GetTrackPlayback (query uid, sid, exp and sig), because audio elements, casting devices and players cannot send a token header. With audioFormats, it answers 406 instead of a file the client cannot play.

parameters.name: audioFormats
parameters.description: The audio formats the client plays (at most 20, repeated query parameter); optional.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: Signed media URL: id of the user the URL was issued to.

parameters.name: sid
parameters.description: Signed media URL: id of the session the URL was issued in.

parameters.name: exp
parameters.description: Signed media URL: expiry in Unix seconds.

206.description: The requested range of the file.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`), has no audio file (code `track.no_audio`) or its audio file is gone since the last scan (code `stream.file_missing`).

406.description: The client supports none of the formats of the file (code `stream.transcoding_required`).

416.description: The requested range is outside the file; as usual for range requests, without body and with Content-Range: bytes */length.

get.summary: Decides how the client plays the video of a track from what it supports: directly, if it plays the container, the video codec (H.264 only as 8 bit 4:2:0) and the audio codec of the file, otherwise transcoded to H.264 and AAC as an HLS stream. Videos read by an older version of the scan are transcoded until the next scan. The answer contains a signed, short-lived stream URL that works without the session token, for example in a video element: the file (protocol File) or the HLS master playlist (protocol Hls; null if transcoding is unavailable).

parameters.name: videoContainers
parameters.description: The containers the client plays (at most 20, repeated query parameter).

parameters.name: videoCodecs
parameters.description: The video codecs the client plays (at most 20, repeated query parameter).

parameters.name: audioCodecs
parameters.description: The audio codecs the client plays in videos (at most 20, repeated query parameter).

200.description: How the client plays the video.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`), has no video (code `track.no_video`) or its video is gone since the last scan (code `stream.file_missing`).

get.summary: Streams the video of a track as it is, with HTTP range requests (Accept-Ranges: bytes, 206 Partial Content), a strong ETag of the file version, Last-Modified and Cache-Control: private, no-cache. Besides the session token, it accepts the signed URL of GetTrackVideoPlayback (query uid, sid, exp and sig), because video elements, casting devices and players cannot send a token header.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: Signed media URL: id of the user the URL was issued to.

parameters.name: sid
parameters.description: Signed media URL: id of the session the URL was issued in.

parameters.name: exp
parameters.description: Signed media URL: expiry in Unix seconds.

206.description: The requested range of the file.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`), has no video (code `track.no_video`) or its video is gone since the last scan (code `stream.file_missing`).

416.description: The requested range is outside the file; as usual for range requests, without body and with Content-Range: bytes */length.

get.summary: Returns whether transcoding works, the result of the detection of the graphics hardware (Intel Quick Sync) and how many transcodes run.
Lists the running transcodes, newest first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of transcodes of the page.

delete.summary: Stops a running transcode. A player that still needs its segments starts a new one.

404.description: No transcode with the id is running (code `transcode.job_not_found`).

get.summary: Lists the users, sorted and optionally filtered by role.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of users of the page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort key; ties are sorted by id.

post.summary: Creates a user. Missing initials are derived from the name, a missing color is the least used one.

201.description: The created user; Location points to it.

get.summary: Returns a user.

404.description: The user does not exist (code `user.not_found`).

patch.summary: Changes a user. Missing or null values stay unchanged.

404.description: The user does not exist (code `user.not_found`).

delete.summary: Deletes a user with its settings and sessions.

404.description: The user does not exist (code `user.not_found`).

409.description: The built-in admin profile cannot be deleted (code `user.built_in_admin`).

get.summary: Lists the years of the tracks with the number of their tracks and albums.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of years of the page.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Sort direction; the newest year first by default.

parameters.name: myMusic
parameters.description: Only years of the "my music" of the current profile, counted over these tracks.

entries.description: The new entries, in the order of the request.

AddedPlaylistEntries.description: The entries added to a playlist and the playlist afterwards.

trackIds.description: The tracks to add, in this order; duplicates are allowed.

position.description: Position of the first added entry, from 0 to the number of entries; the entries from there move back. At the end if missing.

oneOf.description: Album artist; null for compilations and albums without a known artist.

isCompilation.description: Tracks of several artists without a common album artist. Clients show their own text for it.

genre.description: The first genre of its tracks in the order of disc and track number.

durationMilliseconds.description: Sum of the durations of the tracks in milliseconds.

hasCover.description: Whether the album or one of its tracks has a cover (GetAlbumCover).

firstSeenAt.description: When the album was found for the first time.

items.description: Items of the page, at most limit.
